tools.name: list_video_models
tools.description: List available video models and their capabilities. Video generation consumes credits; use get_video_model for detailed pricing.

tools.name: get_video_model
tools.description: Get full capabilities and credit pricing for one video model. Generating a video with this model consumes credits.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Create a video generation task. Ultra ViewMax C1 generations cost 0 credits within the daily fair-use pool (also via REST API); otherwise this consumes credits from the authenticated ViewMax account.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get the current status and output URLs for one of the authenticated user's tasks (video, image, music, or audio). Generation consumes credits when created.

tools.name: wait_for_task
tools.description: Wait up to 50 seconds for a task and return its latest status. Some videos take several minutes: keep calling wait_for_task until status is success, failed, or canceled. Task results are persisted and never lost.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Get the authenticated account's remaining credits. Generation consumes credits.

tools.name: list_image_models
tools.description: List available image models with their modes (text-to-image, image-to-image), aspect ratios, qualities, and credit labels. Image generation consumes credits.

tools.name: get_image_model
tools.description: Get full capabilities and credit pricing for one image model. Generating an image with this model consumes credits.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Create an image generation task (text-to-image, or image-to-image when image_urls are provided). Pro/Ultra flagship models (GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Grok Imagine) and Ultra ViewMax C1 cost 0 credits within the shared daily fair-use pool; otherwise this consumes credits. tools.name: list_music_models
tools.description: List available music models and their controls (duration, instrumental) and credit cost. Music generation consumes credits.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Create an original music track from a text prompt. This consumes credits. Music renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List available text-to-speech voices (id, name, gender, accent, language) and the per-generation credit cost.

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Convert text to speech with a selected voice_id (see list_voices). This consumes credits. Speech renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

tools.name: generate_sound_effect
tools.description: Generate a sound effect from a text prompt. This consumes credits. Renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.
